title: 📐 Delivery, Calibration & QC — CPRP 1
ps_sub: Delivery, Calibration & Quality Control · B1+ · self-marking
foot: 📐 CPRP 1 · Delivery, Calibration & Quality Control — B1+ · self-marking 📐
story: Théo works in the goods-in area of a machining workshop. Every morning, a lorry delivers raw material — steel bars and aluminium plates — on pallets. He checks the delivery note, counts the parts and signs for the order. Nobody can start a job before the material is checked.

Yesterday, before a big production run, Théo calibrated the milling machine and set the tool offsets. Then the team machined the first part and measured it with a caliper. The dimension was inside the tolerance, so the run began.

Since Monday, the workshop has produced 500 parts and has inspected every batch. The inspectors have rejected only three parts so far. They haven't found any serious defect yet. Théo says good calibration is the most important step of the day. 📐
